reason: I'd sign up for the free tier and poke at it, but I'm not paying for this. I can write a Playwright script with a cron job in an afternoon, and my clients have never asked me for a dated archive of their pages, so it's not something I can bill them for.
objection: It says right there it never bypasses bot protection, and half my clients sit behind Cloudflare. So on exactly the sites where I'd want it, it might just capture a challenge page. My own script runs from my machine with my session, so it gets through. Pasting a client's browser session into a new service with no reviews also makes me nervous.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it capture a real client site that's behind Cloudflare and a cookie banner on the free tier without me babysitting it, or a client asking for before/after reports I could charge for. If either happened, the $79 lifetime deal would be an easy yes.
